title: LGR Dehumidifier Sizing Covered by Dwelling Coverage, Water Damage Mitigation
content:
Under this Water Damage Mitigation coverage standard, LGR dehumidifiers are covered up to the IICRC sizing across the job's LGR dehumidifier lines.

## Standard
On a Class 3 or Class 4 job carrying LGR lines the covered units are one for every 500 square feet of the affected floor area plus one for every 50 linear feet of the baseboard run on the job's baseboard removal lines, each term rounded up on its own, because wet walls add evaporation load; on a Class 2 job carrying LGR lines they are the floor term alone. The covered LGR unit-days are the covered units multiplied by the number of LGR lines, and the total unit-days on those lines above the covered unit-days, priced at the tier's LGR dehumidifier daily rate, are a non-covered amount. On any other job every billed LGR unit-day is covered.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: affected floor area 1200 square feet, baseboard run 120 linear feet, 5 LGR lines carrying 34 unit-days, assumed LGR rate $100.00)
- Floor term: 1200 divided by 500 is 2.4, rounded up to 3. Wall term: 120 divided by 50 is 2.4, rounded up to 3.
- Class 3 or Class 4: 6 covered units; covered unit-days 30; 4 unit-days above them give $400.00 non-covered.
- Class 2: 3 covered units; covered unit-days 15; 19 unit-days above them give $1900.00 non-covered.
- Class 1: every billed LGR unit-day is covered.
